name: clipboard
pattern: A headless copy trigger writing through the Async Clipboard API
responsibility: Extracts text from the consumer-selected source and passes it to navigator.clipboard.writeText() from trusted user activation. Reports success/failure through events; generates no notification UI or content.

authorMarkup.trigger: A native <button type="button"> with data-clipboard-target="trigger"; the consumer supplies its label
authorMarkup.source: An element with data-clipboard-target="source", required only when the source value is "target"
authorMarkup.content: The controller generates neither elements/content nor success/failure notifications.

semanticElements: Exactly one trigger target is required.
Each trigger must be an HTMLButtonElement with type="button"
source must be target, text, or selection.
Exactly one source target is required when source=target.
text must be nonempty when source=text.
contractValidation.invalidMarkup: Validate markup and values on connection. Invalid configuration prevents listeners and copying and warns once per connection. Do not throw.
contractValidation.warning: Warnings identify clipboard controller and the invalid element type or value name.

source.description: Source kind: target reads the source target, text reads the text value, and selection reads the selection within the root.

copy(event).description: Requires a trusted user-activation event and is intended for Stimulus actions. Calls without an event or with isTrusted=false resolve without writing or emitting custom events. Firefox and WebKit require transient activation, so the controller does not attempt a write without it.

clipboard:beforecopy.when: After resolving source text from trusted trigger activation, before writing
clipboard:beforecopy.effect: preventDefault() suppresses both the write and clipboard:copy.

clipboard:copy.when: After a trusted-activation write attempt resolves or rejects. No event is emitted when no write is attempted, including missing activation, empty source, or selection outside the root.

detail.error: The DOMException on failure, or null on success

events.notification: No notification UI is supplied. Consumers handle clipboard:copy and pass the result to a toast or another UI.
events.synthetic: Do not write or emit custom events for clicks with isTrusted=false because clipboard access requires transient activation.
events.programmatic: copy() requires a trusted event, so it has no programmatic origin. Calls without events do nothing, and reason has no programmatic value.
events.emptySource: Do not write or emit beforecopy/copy for empty sources: empty source targets, empty text, empty selection, or selection outside the root. Writing an empty string could unintentionally erase the user's clipboard.

consumerIntegration.stimulusActions: Listen for clipboard:copy and clipboard:beforecopy on the root or an ancestor. The controller does not stop propagation.
consumerIntegration.cancelableHook: Cancel writing with event.preventDefault() in a clipboard:beforecopy listener.
consumerIntegration.programmatic: Calling copy() from another controller without activation does nothing and emits no clipboard:copy because no write is attempted. This component does not support automatic copying without user interaction.
consumerIntegration.nested: Use :self or event.target === event.currentTarget to restrict events to the root when listening outside nested clipboard controllers.

behavior.sourceTarget: Read value from input/textarea source targets and textContent from other elements.
behavior.sourceSelection: Copy only selections within the root. Do not write for empty selections or selections outside it.
behavior.multipleRange: In engines supporting multiple selection ranges, use Selection.toString() unchanged, leaving concatenation order and separators to the engine.
behavior.richText: Use writeText() only; ClipboardItem formats such as text/html are outside scope.
behavior.fallback: Do not fall back to document.execCommand("copy"). Unsupported environments report clipboard:copy with detail.ok=false.
behavior.activation: Firefox/WebKit require transient user activation; Chromium may also allow clipboard-write permission. Do not normalize these permission differences; report writeText() failures from each engine.

managedMarkup.aria: Consumers supply trigger labels and result notifications. The controller adds no ARIA.
managedMarkup.stateOnly: No state outputs: copying is transient and has no persistent component state.
managedMarkup.preservation: Preserve authored id, type, ARIA, and other attributes.

stateOutputs.ownership: No state outputs; report success/failure through event detail.

lifecycle: Register trigger click in connect(); remove it in disconnect().
Do not emit custom events for write promises settling after disconnect().
Do not duplicate listeners or custom events when reconnecting the same instance

observations.environment: Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit multi-range selections
observations.impact: Selection serialization is delegated to the platform; no alternative serialization or public API is selected from these observations.

acceptanceCriteria: The behavior and accessibility implemented by this component must meet WCAG 2.2 Level AA.

Required AAA criteria: 2.1.3 Keyboard (No Exception), with no pointer-only features; and 3.2.5 Change on Request, with controller focus movement limited to user actions or consumer JS calls, never timers.
Only trusted trigger activation emits one cancelable beforecopy followed by one copy result, in that order.
Canceling beforecopy prevents both the write and the copy event.
All four source forms reach writeText(): source-target value, source-target textContent, text value, and root-contained selection.
Report detail.ok=false and detail.error only for attempted writes that fail. No attempt means no event.
The controller generates no notification UI or elements.
Invalid markup disables enhancement with one warning
Pass automated tests in Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit.
Verify transient activation through Stimulus actions in each engine and record differences in docs/notes/browser-engine-differences.md.
Report engine differences in multi-range Selection.toString() concatenation as unverified.

testMatrix.description: Passing input value and element textContent to writeText
Passing fixed text value to writeText
Passing root-contained selection to writeText and excluding outside selection
beforecopy cancellation preventing write and copy events
Write rejection reported through detail.ok=false and detail.error
No write or events from clicks with isTrusted=false
Disconnect/reconnect listener cleanup and no events from promises settling after disconnection

testMatrix: Engine-specific results for Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit

mutation.description: Disable isValidMarkup() and continue enhancement with a non-button trigger.
Ignore beforecopy dispatchEvent's return value and always write.
Remove the empty-string check and call writeText.
Remove the check that selection is within the root.
Ignore promise rejection and report ok=true.

negativeControls.guard: Listener cleanup and suppressing promises settling after disconnection

mutation.description: Remove both the disconnected-state check and listener cleanup from disconnect(), breaking the independent guards together.
